correctness.rationale: For every q≥3 and n≥4, the successor-consistency criterion is proved and suffices to construct the feedback map. Distinct spike colors preclude common contexts containing nonzero symbols; same colors with unequal gaps permit at most one spike alignment; antipodal same-color spikes halve the least period. Tight upper and lower predecessor-conflict lengths prove all four cases. Pair counts derive the coefficient formula. A standalone stdlib checker independently replays 28,280 finite word cases and 60 histograms plus 210 pairwise comparisons, with no finite-to-infinite inference.

value.rationale: The two-spike family is a canonical Hamming-weight-two testbed for nonlinear feedback register length. The result gives all alphabet sizes and periods, isolates the genuinely different same-color and distinct-color mechanisms, discovers the sharp near-one-third gap transition and antipodal period collapse, and enumerates the full complexity spectrum rather than a chosen computational instance. It does not claim cryptographic guarantees or a general theorem for unrestricted Hamming weights.
